user.title: RoomCall intercom
user.description: Choose the speakers that should play intercom messages. Rooms come from each speaker's Home Assistant area. Pick one entity per physical speaker so messages are not played twice.

data_description.volume: Leave empty to keep each speaker's current volume. Supported by Sonos.
data_description.gain_db: Raise this if phone recordings sound quiet.
data_description.chime: A short walkie-talkie chirp before every message so people know a call is coming.

broadcast.name: Broadcast
broadcast.description: Speak a message or play an audio URL in one or more rooms through RoomCall speakers.

areas.name: Rooms
areas.description: Areas to broadcast to. Leave empty for every RoomCall speaker.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text spoken with the configured text-to-speech engine.

media_url.name: Media URL
media_url.description: Audio file URL or media-source ID to play instead of a message.
